name: Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Advani Hotels and Resorts India Ltd is in the business of hoteliering
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AHRIL owns and operates the Caravela Beach Resort, Goa; an independent, 201-key, 5-Star Deluxe golf resort on the Arabian Sea, designed by the world-famous architects WATG
The Caravela is located on a 23-acre estate with a 275-meter long beach-front at Varca Beach, South Goa. It is surrounded by landscaped gardens and a golf course designed by the international landscape architect, Belt Collins.

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 3.51%.
Company has delivered good profit growth of 18.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 39.8%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 84.9%
